items.label: Ponds per chunk
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R17), until the real map design exists. How many ponds are randomly scattered in a chunk when it's first created, on top of the one guaranteed pond near the starting site.

items.label: Pond min radius
items.description: Placeholder. A pond's smallest possible radius, in meters (half of the smallest 3 m across).

items.label: Pond max radius
items.description: Placeholder. A pond's largest possible radius, in meters (half of the largest 8 m across).

items.label: Pond max drinks
items.description: Placeholder. How many drinks a full pond holds.

items.label: Pond refill per hour
items.description: Placeholder. How many drinks a pond refills per game hour, up to full.

items.label: Pond pathfinding cost
items.description: Placeholder. How many times more a pond's water costs to path through than normal ground - walkable, but avoided when a reasonable detour exists. Read by People, not by Ponds, the same way setting.time.real_seconds_per_day is read by People but owned by time_settings.json.

items.label: Starting pond min distance
items.description: Placeholder. The guaranteed starting pond's shortest possible distance from the starting site, in meters.

items.label: Starting pond max distance
items.description: Placeholder. The guaranteed starting pond's longest possible distance from the starting site, in meters.
